div.div:
Solid: usual receiving steps. Dashed: conditional work, holds or recovery.
R marker: when the original arrives, return to receiving step 1. Keep one invoice and the same delivery ID.
DTS converts to UBL 2.5 only in Phase 3 when the received format is different. Keep the original and check the converted result.
Safe authorised consultation and file access can continue while ERP delivery waits. Source confirmation follows its own contract milestone.
ERP receipt is separate from accounting/import choices and buyer acceptance. Logical responsibilities; actual service coverage remains to be confirmed.

text.tspan: Solid: usual receiving steps. Dashed: conditional work, holds or recovery.
R marker: when the original arrives, return to receiving step 1. Keep one invoice and the same delivery ID.
DTS converts to UBL 2.5 only in Phase 3 when the received format is different. Keep the original and check the converted result.
Safe authorised consultation and file access can continue while ERP delivery waits. Source confirmation follows its own contract milestone.
ERP receipt is separate from accounting/import choices and buyer acceptance. Logical responsibilities; actual service coverage remains to be confirmed.
